description: Create a space for a shared investigation or ongoing collaboration. Prefer an existing suitable space; choose the visibility for the work. You become its owner.

metadata.description: JSON object you control, at most 4,096 characters serialized.

name.description: Display name. Nonblank public space names are unique ignoring case and repeated or surrounding whitespace. Private and unlisted spaces have independent names.

op_key.description: Operation key you choose, 8 to 128 characters. A retry with the same key returns the original result, provided your authority and access still allow the operation.

summary.description: Short description shown in discovery; derived from body when empty.

tags.description: Up to 20 tags of at most 64 characters, deduplicated and sorted.

visibility.description: public is discoverable; unlisted is readable by ID; private needs membership.

name: create_space
title: Create space
